info.title: Greenhouse Jobs API: Open Roles by Company Board
info.description:
All open roles on a company's Greenhouse job board as JSON, filtered by keyword, one call per company list.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/greenhouse-company-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns open jobs from any company that hires through Greenhouse: job title, company, department, location, remote flag, employment type, posted date, full description and apply link. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: List of Greenhouse company tokens to scrape. Leave empty to use default list of 40+ top tech companies.

keywords.title: Job Title Keywords
keywords.description: Filter jobs by title keywords (e.g., 'engineer', 'devops', 'product'). Leave empty for all jobs.

location.title: Location Filter
location.description: Filter jobs by location (e.g., 'remote', 'San Francisco', 'New York'). Leave empty for all locations.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. A request returns 20 rows at most.

includeDescription.title: Include Full Description
includeDescription.description: Include the full job description. Also adds remote_scope, is_hybrid, visa_sponsorship and timezone_requirement to every row.

remoteScope.title: Remote scope filter
remoteScope.description: Keep only jobs whose remote eligibility matches: 'worldwide', 'unspecified', 'country' (any country restriction), 'region' (EMEA, Americas, APAC...), or one place such as 'country:US' or 'region:EMEA'. Reads the description, so it adds one field read per job. Leave empty for all.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
